# Oral-B

> > Oral-B is a comprehensive oral care platform offering electric toothbrushes, manual toothbrushes, floss, water flossers, and dental hygiene products with smart technology integration.

Oral-B provides a full range of oral care solutions from the flagship iO Series electric toothbrushes with A.I. brushing recognition to sustainable manual options like Clic. The site features interactive tools for product discovery, comparison, and personalized recommendations to help customers find the right dental care products.

## Key Topics

- Oral-B iO Series
- Electric toothbrushes
- Smart Modes
- A.I. Brushing Recognition
- Oral-B app
- Water Flosser Advanced
- Bluetooth connectivity
- Replacement brush heads
- Clic manual toothbrush
- Gum care
- Dental floss
- Product comparison
- Gift guides
- Oral hygiene
- ADA approved
